mechanism_inventory: access-control mismatch on setRouter (missing onlyOwner/access guard — anyone can call setRouter to replace the router address)
unauthorized state deletion / token supply manipulation via mint/burn after router hijack
missing invariant enforcement — mintByOwner has no cross-chain accounting guard
value exceeds logical/economic bound — unbounded mint by owner or hijacked router inflates supply beyond bridge-backed collateral
external-call failure / DoS — burn(_from,_amount) by onlyRouter with arbitrary _from could burn arbitrary user balances if router is malicious/hijacked
wrong lifecycle ordering — setRouter callable after mint/burn begins, retroactively changing authorization

selected_mechanisms.root_cause: setRouter is a public function with no access control modifier. Any external caller can invoke setRouter(attackerAddress), replacing the legitimate router. The attacker then becomes the onlyRouter-authorized caller and can mint() arbitrary tokens to any address or burn() any user's tokens.
selected_mechanisms.attacker_model: Unprivileged EOA. No role/allowance. Single permissionless tx to setRouter(self), then mint(self, large) or burn(victim, victimBalance).
selected_mechanisms.exploit_path: 1. Attacker calls DcntEth.setRouter(attacker) — succeeds (no access modifier). 2. Attacker calls DcntEth.mint(attacker, arbitraryLargeAmount) — succeeds (msg.sender==router). 3. Attacker holds newly minted DcntEth redeemable through the bridge for real ETH, or burn(victim, victimBalance) to destroy holdings.
selected_mechanisms.who_loses: All DcntEth holders (dilution via unbounded mint; direct loss via unauthorized burn). Bridge loses solvency if minted exceeds locked ETH.
selected_mechanisms.who_gains: Attacker gains minted tokens redeemable for bridge ETH, or griefs via burn.
selected_mechanisms.why_carried: setRouter has zero access control — direct, permissionless, source-proven path to full mint/burn bypass. Highest severity. Source: `function setRouter(address _router) public { router = _router; }` — no modifier.

selected_mechanisms.root_cause: mintByOwner allows the owner to mint arbitrary DcntEth without any corresponding cross-chain lock/accounting, breaking the invariant minted==ETH locked, creating unbacked tokens redeemable for real ETH.
selected_mechanisms.attacker_model: Privileged (owner). Requires the owner key or a compromised owner.
selected_mechanisms.exploit_path: 1. Owner mintByOwner(anyAddress, large). 2. Minted tokens have no ETH backing. 3. Redeemed through the bridge, draining locked ETH.
selected_mechanisms.who_loses: Bridge LP / locked ETH depositors lose real ETH backing.
selected_mechanisms.why_carried: Different authorization path (onlyOwner vs onlyRouter) and invariant (bridge collateral conservation); distinct trust-assumption violation affecting solvency.

unresolved_mechanisms.mechanism: burn(_from,_amount) by malicious/hijacked router destroying arbitrary user balances without consent
unresolved_mechanisms.source_evidence: `function burn(address _from, uint256 _amount) public onlyRouter { _burn(_from, _amount); }` — _from attacker-supplied once router compromised; no approval/consent check.
unresolved_mechanisms.unresolved_question: Whether OFTv2's _burn requires a prior allowance from _from to msg.sender; if not, any router can burn any user's tokens. Execution-dependent on inherited _burn (not in source).
unresolved_mechanisms.who_loses: Arbitrary DcntEth holders whose balances are burned without consent.

rejected_mechanisms.mechanism: wrong lifecycle ordering — setRouter after mint/burn
rejected_mechanisms.rejecting_source_fact: Subsumed by the access-control mismatch; no separate lifecycle bug distinct from the missing guard.
rejected_mechanisms.why_unexploitable: Root cause is the missing access control, not sequencing.

impact_direction.attacker_receives: Unbounded minted DcntEth redeemable for real ETH from the bridge reserve (permissionless router hijack + mint). Gain proportional to bridge TVL.
impact_direction.attacker_preserves: Nothing needed — entry permissionless, zero cost beyond gas.
impact_direction.victim_loses: All DcntEth holders lose value via dilution; individual holders lose entire balance if burn is called on them; bridge LPs lose ETH backing.
impact_direction.invariant_violated: Cross-chain bridge collateral invariant: minted DcntEth must equal ETH locked. Permissionless setRouter + mint breaks this; onlyRouter authorization fully bypassed.
impact_direction.not_self_funded_or_dust_or_admin_or_timi: Fully permissionless (no role/admin/timing); profit scales with bridge TVL; not dust.

stop_condition: more_mechanisms_pending: burn-of-arbitrary-victim unresolved (OFTV2 _burn allowance) + mintByOwner collateral invariant carried
